remarks: Welcome to Aloft Skyview! Built in 2024, this stunning 580 sq. ft. condo offers modern living in the desirable community of Pembina! This beautifully designed third-floor, one-bedroom, one-bathroom unit features a bright, open-concept layout, 9-foot ceilings, luxury vinyl plank flooring, and a gorgeous kitchen complete with white cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious island with breakfast-bar seating. Enjoy the convenience of in-suite laundry and your own private balcony, perfect for relaxing or enjoying your morning coffee. A rare bonus is the TWO parking stalls, including one heated underground and one above ground! Residents can also enjoy the building’s rooftop patio, ideal for entertaining or taking in the views. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, grocery stores, public transit, and major commuter routes, including Yellowhead Trail and Anthony Henday Drive. Perfect for first-time buyers, professionals, or investors! (id:67522)
